contea di ritrovamento: Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)
D/ [DN] CONSTANTIVS IVN NOB [C] ; R/ GLOR [IA EXERC] ITVS

Copper alloy coin. Nummus of Constantius II (323-361), Gloria Exercitus issue of 330-335, possibly Trier mint, Reece period 17. Obverse description: Bust laureate cuirassed right. Obverse inscription: [DN] CONSTANTIVS IVN NOB [C]. Reverse description: Two soldiers with two standards between them. Reverse inscription: GLOR [IA EXERC] ITVS. In exergue: [-]P.T. Diameter: 12.7mm, Weight: 1.44gms, die…
